sentiment.label: Mixed
sentiment.summary: ANT still had not traded as of 11:35am ET, two hours after the open, so the mood rests on pre-listing coverage: strong demand and above-range pricing set against an unusually delayed debut and valuation questions. I found little new this hour.
points: Anthropic priced at $83, above the $70-78 range, selling 980 million Class A shares for about $81.3bn, per its announcement
Stock Titan's live page said at 11:35am ET that ANT had still not traded and no start time was set
Stock Titan's market summary says tech stocks gave up early gains ahead of the expected debut
Investinglive, citing the WSJ, earlier said some investors had pushed for a lower valuation after a tech selloff

updates.text: Anthropic filed its final prospectus with the SEC on the morning of 19 November, confirming 980 million Class A shares at $83 (about $81.3bn). The sale is expected to close on 20 November, with a separate $26bn Class N share sale to seven tech companies to follow and a 30-day option for banks to buy up to 147 million more shares.

Khaleej Times reports that Anthropic is expected to join at least six major indexes, including the Nasdaq 100, within 5 to 15 days of listing, and that a separate $26 billion private sale with cornerstone investors is also planned.

Anthropic prices its IPO at $83 a share, above the $70–78 range, selling 980 million shares and raising $81.3 billion. Trading on Nasdaq under ANT is expected from 9:30am New York time on 19 November.
